label: conj:tannaka-krein-isomorphism
title: Tannaka--Krein duality for the substrate
html:
Conjecture. Tannaka--Krein duality for the substrate

Conjecture. Tannaka--Krein duality establishes a self-duality between two perspectives on the substrate:

\mathbf{Rep}_{\mathrm{loc}}(A) \simeq \mathbf{Comod}(\mathcal{H}_\xi),

an equivalence of categories lying over the fibre functor \tau.

Here, \mathbf{Rep}_{\mathrm{loc}}(A) is the category of localized A-module representations, supported at maximal ideals. The category \mathbf{Comod}(\mathcal{H}_\xi) consists of comodules over the Hopf algebra \mathcal{H}_\xi reconstructed from the Reeb spectrum. The geometric side of localized representations at defects matches the spectral side of global quantum group symmetries of the Reeb flow. The fibre functor \tau underlying this equivalence sends each localized module to its fiber at the unit defect. The reconstruction theorem guarantees that \mathcal{H}_\xi is uniquely determined by the monoidal structure of \mathbf{Rep}_{\mathrm{loc}}(A).

Compatibility with \tau is part of the statement, not a decoration. An equivalence that did not commute with the fibre functors would not be the duality claimed here: many inequivalent Hopf algebras have equivalent comodule categories, and it is precisely \tau that separates them. The formalisation therefore carries the equivalence and its compatibility as a single condition --- \tau_{\mathbf{Comod}} \circ e \cong \tau_{\mathbf{Rep}} for the same e --- rather than as two independent assertions, which would permit an equivalence and an unrelated natural isomorphism.

What is open. The two categories above are different categories, and nothing in the framework relates them. The Lean carrier IsTannakaKreinDual states the condition over arbitrary parameter categories and is satisfiable --- a category is dual to itself over its own fibre functor --- but that witness is the identity equivalence and establishes only that the condition is satisfiable in principle. No instance is supplied for \mathbf{Rep}_{\mathrm{loc}}(A) and \mathbf{Comod}(\mathcal{H}_\xi); supplying one is the conjecture.
